[P2] Allow partial collection after verified no-work failures

A missing fixture makes `start()` delete the empty case, but the coordinator still calls `collect_partial()` after `NotImplementedError`. This lookup raises, creating a cleanup error and quarantining the target despite successful no-work retirement. `finish(quiescent=False)` then retains the persistent fence, blocking subsequent runs. Return empty partial evidence for explicitly verified no-work cases. Add a coordinator regression using the actual `SharedAdapter`; the existing missing-fixture coordinator test overrides `collect_partial()` and bypasses this failure.
